reason: `is_safe_url` calls `strip_control_chars` before validation, and `sanitize_markdown_link` also strips the URL before passing it to the validator. Thus control-containing URLs can be accepted and emitted as links instead of rejected.

The implementation removes control characters before checking the URL, so a URL containing a newline or tab can be normalized into an allowed URL and accepted. For example, `https://exa\nmple.org` becomes `https://example.org`, contrary to Req 1’s requirement to reject whitespace control characters.
